dev.//: The PUBLIC gateway on :8787 — what the browser's `/v1/*` reaches (through the web app's `/llm-gateway` proxy). The backend does NOT call this one: its `SERVICE_LLM_GATEWAY` binding resolves to the copy `lunora dev` runs inside the backend's own session (`backend/lunora.config.ts`). So two gateways run in dev, each with its own local KV/D1 state.
